info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Investment Portfolio Statements-v1-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Statements Retrieval API enables users to access detailed statements for their investment portfolios. This API serves as a crucial resource for investors seeking to monitor their financial performance over time. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can integrate portfolio statement retrieval functionalities into their applications, allowing users to view historical data, performance summaries, and transactional details. Typical consumers include financial advisors, investment firms, and individual investors looking to make informed decisions based on their investment history.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the statements associated with a user's portfolio, allowing for insights into the performance and composition of the portfolio over time.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the portfolio statements for the specified user. It contains necessary parameters to filter and provide the required statements in the desired format.

ListInvestmentPortfolioStatementsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for getting portfolio statements. It should be provided in JSON format.
